transcript.answer: No. Otto's spec for support-agent TMS access (FR-031 and FR-034) says tool definitions registered in apps/api must not declare a customer id, company id or account number in their input schema. Customer scope has to come from the customer scope resolver, not from tool input. Issue #560 (T006) adds a guard in `apps/api/src/tools/registerTools.ts` that refuses any tool whose inputSchema declares such a field. Its acceptance criterion is that a tool declaring a customer id in its input schema is refused, and its test is customerBoundary.test.ts. Issue #560 is closed, so the guard has presumably been implemented, but I did not check the code to confirm.

judgements.reason: The answer correctly says no and that registerTools refuses such tools. It omits that the ban applies at any depth and to Danish spellings, and that a test walks every registered definition. It also hedges on whether the guard is implemented.
